desc: Accurate, rugged and reliable, the SR1911 is 100% American-made. Positive barrel lock-up allows for a superior accuracy out-of-the-box. Oversized ejection port and extended magazine release. Lightweight, aluminum, skeletonized trigger features an adjustable over-travel stop and provides a very crisp, no creep, light trigger pull with a quick, positive reset. Skeletonized hammer is lightweight and and provides faster cycling.
